text: Gratiam et pacem a Deo Patre nostro, et Domino Jesu Christo.
note: *Grātiam* keeps its capital: the greeting is its own clause after the address of 1:1–2, as your Gal 1:3, 1 Cor 1:3 and 2 Cor 1:2 (the latter after 2 Cor 1:1's comma); *Patre* capital, God the Father (ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν, decision 20), *nostrō* lower case, as your 2 Cor 1:2 *ā Deō Patre nostrō* (Claude, 2026-11-11)

text: audiens, qua caritate et fide praeditus sis tum in Dominum Jesum, tum erga sanctos omnes,
note: *omnēs,* with 1573's comma (*tum erga ſanctos omnes , 6 quò iſta*, canvas 916), where the draft has no stop: 1:6 *quō* continues the sentence; *audiēns* lower case, the sentence of 1:4 running on (Claude, 2026-11-11)

text: quo ista liberalitate tuae in Christo Jesu collocatae fidei fiat, ut intelligatur, quantum sit in vobis boni.
note: *bonī.* with 1573's full stop (*quantum ſit in vobis boni . 7 Magna quidem*, canvas 916), where the draft has no stop: the sentence of 1:4–6 ends here, and 1:7 *Magnā quidem* (χαρὰν γὰρ) opens a new one, as 1573 and the BSB; *quō* lower case, running on from 1:5 (Claude, 2026-11-11)

text: Quare si me socium habes, accipe eum ut me.
note: paragraph (the BSB's break): after the account of Onesimus (1:10–16), *Quārē sī mē socium habēs* opens the request itself, *accipe eum ut mē* (1:17–20) (Claude, 2026-11-11)

text: Praeterea para mihi hospitium. Spero enim fore, ut vobis per vestras preces condoner.
note: paragraph (the BSB's break): 1:21 closes the request, and *Prætereā parā mihi hospitium* turns to a new matter, Paul's own coming (Claude, 2026-11-11)

text: Domini nostri Jesu Christi gratia adsit animis vestris: Amen. \\cls Missa est Roma, per Onesimum servum.
note: the subscription set apart as \\cls after the verse (decision 37), as 1573 sets it in italics under the verse (*Miſſa eſt Roma, per Oneſimum ſeruum*, canvas 916, stage 2) and as Titus 3:15, Col 4:18, Phil 4:23; a full stop after it, as the other subscriptions (the crop shows only the tops of 1573's letters); *vestrīs: Āmēn.* with 1573's colon (*animis ve-ſtris: Amen.*), as Col 4:18 (Claude, 2026-11-11)
